about: Regions for the sun layer of the native renderer (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-native-renderer-post-design.md, success criteria 18 and 19), read by tools/xdk_sigmatch/post_sun_layer.py (replay ... --region-file post-regions --spot sunward) and tools/xdk_sigmatch/region_compare.py. The view is the plan's SUNWARD line (-BootSave Hero000, two turns of the right stick, then the camera raised): the hero on the bridge seen from below, the sun behind the upper rail left of the post.
coordinates: rect = [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the picture (0, 0 top left). Chosen on the game's front buffer of capture native_discovery_20261009_134312 frame 1 at the scene's width (out/native-evidence/post/task11_134312_f1_final.png, 1120 x 720; run 413, the same driver line) and confirmed on plan run 3 (log 490, 2026-10-10): on the front buffer of capture native_discovery_20261010_052158 frame 1 (out/native-evidence/post/t10_run3_f1_final.png) and on the emulated shot at 50 s (t10_run3_shot_50s.png: a window shot, the client area below its title bar), which show the same framing; the radial blur's centre is (0.3821, 0.3938) there against (0.3785, 0.3914) in run 413. The raise of the camera ends at its stop before the shots, so the framing repeats from run to run; a plan that ends elsewhere needs its own spot.

kinds.sun: the sun's own place: the radial blur's centre (pixel c31.xy of 4BE4, (0.3785, 0.3914) in the capture) with the glow about it, behind the upper rail
kinds.beams: a beam of the sun layer across darker ground (rail, planks, the hero): where the reference without the sun layer (variant B) is darkest against the game's picture
kinds.sky: open sky beside the sun, clear of leaves, rails and the text box: the control (little of the layer reaches it)
kinds.root: the beams' root, just below the sun's place (pixels 420 to 490 by 320 to 400 of 1120 x 720; review of plan Task 10, Important 4): where the reference with the sun layer is about 1.6 times the game's addition. The regions "beams left" and "beams right" both reach into this zone, so their figures measure the root more than the beams
kinds.far: a beam far down from the sun (pixels 400 to 470 and 470 to 560 by 480 to 640), across the lower rail and the planks: where the reference adds what the game adds
